parameters.name: DeploymentType
parameters.description: The deployment type of the SDG. shared: shared read/write splitting deployment. The content of the SDG is read-only, and data updates are written to the local storage of the instance.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the instances. The value is a JSON array that consists of up to 100 IDs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens deploy-instance-sdg --instance-ids aic-1 --sdg-id sdg-xxxx --deployment-type shared --disk-type standard --disk-access-protocol iscsi --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens DeployInstanceSDG --region cn-hangzhou --SDGId 'sdg-xxxx' --DiskType standard --DeploymentType shared --DiskAccessProtocol iscsi --InstanceIds '["aic-1"]'
